verificationSummary: Editor commit 10ee27089114400468a2faa586997b1bcb15abc9 activates a bounded visible Outline add-node UI for text-block.insert and columns.insert only. src/editor/commands/addNodeVisibleActions.ts derives selected-row and child-flow append actions from the existing node placement readiness matrix and add-node contract builder, requires compatible Backend mutation operation support for the active package 2/document 3 pair, and keeps unsupported add-node kinds such as table, toc, page-break, divider, spacer, table row, and table column out of the visible action set. src/app/useBackendAddNodeMutation.ts sends ready add-node contracts through createBackendAddNodeMutationRequest, FlowDocBackendClient.commitMutation, and applyRuntimeBackendMutationResult so documentId/baseRevision mismatch and stale result gates stay active. src/components/outline/OutlinePanel.tsx renders presentation-only add controls with deterministic data attributes and disabled reasons while EditorApp passes only compatible capability results to the add-node hook/action model. RED evidence included focused tests failing before the visible add-node action model and Outline controls existed, plus npm test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts failing before the disabled-reason precedence fix with expected Backend version capability is not compatible but received Add block is unavailable while another document operation is running. GREEN focused evidence passed npm test -- src/tests/addNodeVisibleActions.test.ts src/tests/outlineScannability.test.ts src/tests/editorBrowserLiveBackendSmokeEvidence.test.ts src/tests/addNodeActivationHarness.test.ts with 4 files and 11 tests. Live browser evidence passed npm run evidence:editor-browser-live-backend-smoke in the Editor worktree and passed again on merged main with FLOWDOC_EVIDENCE_WRITE=0; the smoke output was editor-browser-live-backend-smoke-v1: editor-text-block-zone-cover-body-1 > title > editor-columns-zone-cover-body-2 > summary-columns > detail-table, and the retained fixture records visible UI clicks producing Backend operationKinds text-block.insert and columns.insert before reload, upgrade, and node.reorder. Editor worktree npm run check and merged Editor main npm run check both passed type-check, Vitest with 98 passed test files and 338 tests, and build. This evidence does not enable WYSIWYG behavior, contenteditable runtime, active text input, React canvas typing, durable draft persistence, document v4 insert semantics, generic table/toc/page-break/divider/spacer/table row/table column add paths, production Backend readiness, deployed compatibility, broad corpus coverage, large-document authoring performance, accessibility readiness, exact layout, export parity, broad frontend readiness, Core truth, Backend truth, Editor truth, FlowDoc product truth, or map truth.
